name: Kazami Kazuki
source:
Kazuki is the top idol who inspired Michiru to become an idol herself. Also a magical girl, Kazuki fights evil alongside her familiar Thanatochu the mouse. Although she is fighting for the same cause as Michiru, she is also her rival. She is very loving and overprotective when it comes to her younger brother, Yuuji.
